$comment: Repo registry (policy, no secrets): which repos the factory manages and what it is allowed to do in each. Runtime config stays in factory/config/<owner>_<repo>.json; the per-deployment supervision file with webhook secrets lives in fleet/. Two decisions are policy because their failure mode is not a crash: whether a repo may be auto-merged, and which label makes an issue eligible for pickup. See research/multi-repo-factory-plan.md §5.11.

repos.note: N3 dogfood target. Disabled until an intake adapter exists; autoMerge stays false permanently — the factory opens draft PRs against its own repo and a human merges (§5.11).
